events.name: Wolf Tracks on the Road
events.description: Fresh tracks cross the trade road. A short hunt could yield a pelt — or a bite.

events.name: Lost Child Near the Meadow
events.description: Villagers say a child wandered into the tall grass at dusk. Time is short.

events.name: Merchant Needs Escort
events.description: A trader offers coin and goodwill for safe passage along the old road.

events.name: Light in the Stone Circle
events.description: Travelers report a pale light among the standing stones after midnight.

events.name: Smoke from the Hidden Camp
events.description: Thin smoke rises where no honest camp should be. Someone is watching the road.

events.name: Voices in the Misty Hollow
events.description: Soft voices call from the fog. They know your name — or pretend to.

events.name: Something Moved in the Farmstead
events.description: The abandoned farm is never truly empty. Tonight the shutters bang without wind.

events.name: A Bundle in the River
events.description: Something cloth-wrapped caught on the stones at the crossing. It may not stay long.

events.name: Watchtower Signal
events.description: A faint signal fire gutters at the crumbling tower. Who lit it, and why now?

events.name: Howl from the Deep Woods
events.description: A long howl rolls out of the deep canopy. Packs do not call like that for nothing.

events.name: Footsteps on the Sunken Path
events.description: Someone walked the sunken path at dawn. Their prints stop mid-stride.

events.name: Rare Herbs in Bloom
events.description: A short-lived bloom of rare herbs has been spotted near the pine thicket.

events.name: Thief in the Village
events.description: A purse-cutter is working the square. The vendor will pay for a quiet solution.

events.name: Schoolmaster's Errand
events.description: The school needs a parcel carried to the stone circle before nightfall.

events.name: Chalk Signs on the Road
events.description: Strange chalk marks appeared overnight. Cult work — or a prank with teeth.
